metadata.note: A public HRM invoice-, cheque-, accounts-payable-, or vendor-payment-level dataset was not found. Awarded tenders and quarterly financial summaries must not be relabelled as payments or transactions.

evidence.source: Halifax Open Data / Canadian Urban Data Catalogue finance inventory
evidence.finding: Finance-tagged Halifax Open Data inventory was reviewed; no vendor-payment, cheque-register, invoice-level, or accounts-payable transaction dataset was identified.

evidence.source: HRM Standard Terms and Conditions for Goods, Services and Standing Offers
evidence.finding: Confirms HRM operates an Accounts Payable and electronic vendor-payment process and requires purchase-order references on invoices; it is process evidence, not a public payment ledger.
Confirms HRM reviews payment timeliness and accounts-payable controls; the report does not publish the underlying payment-level ledger.
Provides award/vendor/amount records and is already ingested as procurement evidence. Award value is not proof of an invoice or payment.
Current HalifaxData spending rows are quarterly summary-table evidence. They are not transaction-level accounts-payable records.

recommended_access_path.method: formal HRM data-access / FOIPOP request or proactive Open Data request
recommended_access_path.request_scope: Machine-readable accounts-payable/vendor-payment extract for the longest available retention period, with transaction identifiers and organizational/project coding but excluding banking details and other protected personal information.
recommended_access_path.fallback: If invoice-level identifiers cannot be disclosed, request vendor + payment date + amount + purchase order/contract + cost centre/account/project code at the most granular releasable level.
